name: nightrunner
description: Runs long work across fresh sessions: Claude hands over a note, nightrunner clears the context and the next session carries on from it.

contextBudget.title: Context budget
contextBudget.description: Context size, in tokens, at which nightrunner asks Claude to write a restart prompt and hand over, such as 150k or 300000. Empty means 200k. A default saved through Claude, or /nightrunner start budget=…, takes precedence.
